meta.source: IMF Direction of Trade Statistics (DOTS) — goods trade, USD millions
limitations: Annual data only. Monthly available from UN Comtrade Plus.
Data lag: most countries publish 1–2 years after reference period.
Exports: FOB. Imports: CIF (~5-10% higher). Affects trade balance.
Myanmar post-2021: sparse data, use with caution.
Timor-Leste: very limited statistical capacity; data may be sparse or unavailable.
EU: available in Comtrade mode. IMF DOTS uses U2 (Euro Area) as proxy.
Dependency risk uses combined (export+import) share against total bilateral trade.
meta.dependency_formula: partner_share = (exports_to + imports_from) / (total_exports + total_imports). >40% = high, 20-40% = medium, <20% = low.
meta.refresh_note: Run 'cd pipeline && python fetch_comtrade.py' to refresh. Set COMTRADE_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY in .env for UN Comtrade Plus API. IMF DOTS (free, no key) is used when no key is set.
